utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, any news on that repair drive? I've been hearing bits and pieces but nothing solid.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Ira, I haven't heard anything definite myself. Seems like everyone's got a different story, so I'm just waiting for someone to nail down a date.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's the trouble around here — everyone's got an opinion but nobody's got a fact. I'll just keep my ears open and let you know if I hear something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that—hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Any idea when they'll start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sometime next week, I think? I only caught the tail end of the conversation.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the one organized by that new group? Are you sure it's legit?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't know, Kira. I haven't seen any official flyers or permits.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So without any proof, you're just going to trust them? I'd need to see something official before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I keep forgetting about it. Is that today?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it's today! We're collecting spare tools and materials from everyone this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I think I have some spare screws somewhere. Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A repair drive? Can you tell me more about what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, honestly, I'm not sure — I just heard someone mention it, but I didn't catch the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I see — would you like me to ask around for specifics before we do anything about it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late. Did I miss much on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We just finished setting up the tool stations—Jim's got the grill going for lunch if you're hungry.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh great, Jim's grilling? Count me in—I'll grab a burger after I check on the tool stations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood. I've got some extra tools and time if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam! I could really use an extra set of hands and some tools. Let's meet up tomorrow morning to sort through what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good. What time and where should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know where the repair drive is happening? I need to keep track of the locations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure, actually. I've been focused on the school pickup schedule. Have you heard any details from the organizers?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I haven't spoken to the organizers directly. I was hoping you might have heard something from the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive going on this weekend? I heard they're looking for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yes, I was just about to spread the word! Are you planning to join in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I've already set aside my Saturday morning! I hear they're meeting at the old community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you manage to fix the lawnmower yet, or do you still need a hand with it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the lawnmower? I haven't really had a chance to look at it yet. I might take you up on that offer soon, though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, just let me know when you're ready. Do you think it needs a new blade or just a tune-up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard we're getting that repair drive together for the community tools—did you hear about that too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No, I hadn't heard a thing! What's the plan for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Well, from what I gather, folks are gonna bring in their busted tools next Saturday at the community center, and we'll all pitch in to fix 'em up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, I was thinking we could start the repair drive this Saturday morning—would that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning should be fine. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'll set up the sign-up sheet and make sure we have enough tools. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive the Hendersons are organizing? They're collecting old tools to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I did hear something about that. I've got a few old hammers and wrenches I could spare, as long as they're picked up by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm sure they'd be happy to take those off your hands, Eli. I heard they're stopping by on Saturday morning, so you should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, Vik! Sorry I'm late — did I miss anything important for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane! Just the usual plans — we're all set for Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Saturday morning works for me. Just let me know what tools you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don't know much about it, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's alright. Maybe someone else knows more about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, Opal. Something about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hmm, yes, last I saw it, it was in the shed behind your house, but I'd double-check if anyone moved it lately.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll peek in the shed when I get a minute. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I heard you're organizing a repair drive — that's awesome! I might know some folks from the book club who'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, thanks Jules! I'm still sorting out the specifics — do you know what kind of repairs they're interested in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few of them mentioned they're handy with electronics and small appliances, but I can check more specifically if you need certain skills.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's happening with it again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're collecting broken household items this Saturday at the community center, and I'm hoping to fix up that old clock of yours if you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the clock! I keep meaning to bring that in. Saturday, you said?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, any update on when the repair drive people might swing by the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven't heard a set date yet, but if you need a wrench or a ladder in the meantime, you know where to find me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Appreciate that, Gus. I'll keep my toolbox handy and let you know if I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're planning a repair drive. Need any extra hands or tools from my garage?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I could use a cordless drill and someone to help haul old wood.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a cordless drill, and I'll be free Saturday morning to help haul that wood.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, is everyone actually coordinating the repair times, or are we just hoping nobody shows up at the same spot?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Honestly, I haven't heard of any schedule. Are you worried about overlap?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, exactly — if two people end up at the same house with tools, it’s just going to cause confusion and wasted effort.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yes, I've been gathering some spare parts and tools for it. What kind of supplies are you looking for?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Cleo! I think we're looking for anything from old electronics to garden tools—basically anything that can be fixed up and reused.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I can help coordinate the sign-ups if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, right... I think so? Did we set a time already?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don't think we pinned down a time yet—how about Saturday morning around 10? That usually works best for folks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I was just going over the volunteer list for the repair drive and wanted to check in with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Rosa! I've heard bits and pieces about the drive from folks around here, but I'm not sure what I can offer yet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all, Nell! Even if you could just help spread the word or lend a hand with sign-ins on the day, that would be wonderful.
